title: EvalRun
description: One immutable measurement of one Configuration against one Suite. A re-run is a new run; runs are never edited. A run missing any element of the attribution tuple is not scorable, because a score is a product of the model, the harness, the environment and the grader — change any one and the number moves.

by_failure_mode.description: Score broken down by the failure mode each case names. An aggregate that cannot be decomposed by failure mode tells you the system got worse, not where.

cost.description: Cost is a dimension of the result, not a footnote. Cost-driven degradation — token truncation, fallback to a weaker model, aggressive caching — degrades correctness without triggering any alert, which makes budget a correctness constraint rather than an economic one.

grader_health.description: Present whenever any case was judged. Absent means no judge was involved — never that the judge was fine.

detector_recall.description: Recall of each detector, measured against mutation probes applied to THIS run's own outcomes. Recall is a property of (detector, configuration), not of a detector alone: the same detector had 10-15 points more recall against structured output than against prose, and that gap alone produced a confident wrong finding. Absent means recall was not measured — never that it was adequate.

probe_corpus_version.description: Recall measured under different probe corpora is not comparable. Without this field that incomparability is undetectable, so the comparator refuses when two runs disagree here.

substrates.description: Run outcomes on which this detector was silent before mutation. A probe proves nothing on an outcome that already carried the property. Zero substrates means the detector fired on everything — the recall-1.0-and-worthless case — and makes recall unmeasurable rather than perfect.

recall.description: probes_detected / probes_run, or null when probes_run is 0. Null is never 0: zero recall means measured and dead, null means not measurable, and they take different paths — one fails the build, the other refuses the comparison.

scorer_provenance.description: Sample disjointness of a held-out set is insufficient: if the scorer was selected using the optimization set, the promotion decision carries information about that set even when the items are disjoint. The guarantee needs the held-out set and the scorer to be independent of it.

selected_using.description: Dataset the scorer was tuned on, or null if untuned. If this names the optimization set, the held-out claim is void.

provenance.description: How this run was produced, and by WHAT. Unconstrained until 2.0.0 -- typed `object` with a prose description and nothing required, so a run carrying `{}` validated. That is the wrong field to leave open: `provider` is the ONLY thing separating a run that is evidence about a model from one that is evidence about this system's accounting, and a run missing it is not a weaker record, it is an unreadable one.

core_build_hash.description: What the run was computed BY. Empty is worse than absent: `provenance-complete` already treats an empty hash as a failure, and a probe mutates it to prove the detector fires.

configuration_id.description: The hashed Configuration. A comparison across two different configurations is the point; a run that cannot say which one it was is not comparable to anything.

suite_version.description: Which version of the suite produced this. A suite is edited over time and an aggregate is only meaningful against the case list it was scored on.

provider.description: Which transport answered -- `pinned-stub` or a live adapter id such as `local-proxy`. Required because `runSuite` defaults to the stub, and that default is load-bearing: an EvalRun is recomputable from stored artifacts only while nothing in it reached the network. Absent, a stubbed run and a live one are indistinguishable.

decoding.description: Temperature and seed. Null records that none was declared, which is NOT the same as temperature 0 -- see core/src/eval/budget.ts on why a null temperature is not a promise of greedy decoding.

grader_id.description: Null means no judge was involved -- never that a judge was fine.

budget.description: What the run was permitted to spend. Null means no budget was declared, the same reading `admitRun` gives it.
